comment: task recipe-b6b-small-maps-cnc-assembler-nanofab — the Assembler plank-listener pair (Loader_Recipes_OreDict.java:234-238, the OD.plankSkyroot/plankWeedwood/plankWood listener): per registered plank item, 8x plank + 1 redstone dust -> note block (:237, eut 16 / duration 32) and 8x plank + 1 diamond -> jukebox (:238, eut 16 / duration 64), both verbatim. Family expansion is the converged plank face (the TASK planks-blockification CONVERGENCE note at the end of this comment — the 27 OD.plankWood planks x the :237/:238 pair = 54 recipes over the wooddict plank BlockItems and the vanilla identities); rows grouped per material in registration-name order. DECLARED OUT (the same listener's remaining faces, outside this card's bound): the ST.tag(1/2/3/4/6/8) selector rows :242-247 (the press.json:2 form — a configured circuit is not expressible in JSON v1), the bookshelf row :248 (the bookshelf face deferred to the unboxinator card's coordination, the b2a :965 ruling form) and the IGNORED_OREDICT_REGISTRATIONS gate :250. DECLARED SKIPS: the match-stick walk (MultiItemRandomTools.java:344-351, ANY.Wood x ANY.Phosphorus bolt rows) has NO port output carrier — IL.Tool_Matches is not ported (census: zero match item registrations); the Forestry casing row (Compat_Recipes_Forestry.java:319) and the BuildCraft pipe rows (Compat_Recipes_BuildCraft.java:113-118) are the P10 compat cuts. The upstream RecipeMapAssembler subclass face (the printed-pages NBT copy, RecipeMapAssembler.java:43-54) stays POOLED (the GT6RecipeMaps.ASSEMBLER UNBOXINATOR-judged form). KJS: datapack domain, zero adaptation. TASK planks-blockification CONVERGENCE: the retired OP.plank prefix items folded into the wooddict plank faces — the 17 GT6 BlockItem rows (the generic ids plank_wood* kept, the 9 species rows ride the gt-tree-planks <snake>_planks cubes) + the vanilla identities (minecraft:*_planks, the 1.7.10 six + the 1.20.1 tree set); the ~104 mod-wood rows are the compat cut (their planks exist only mod-loaded upstream, the P10 Forestry/BuildCraft ruling) and the Treated pair is CUT with them (the OD.plankWood walk skips meta 10, BlockTreePlanks.java:58-62 `if (i != 10)` — the creosote face) while the Crate pair joins (meta 11 rides the same walk) — the 27 OD.plankWood planks x 2 rows = 54 recipes (16 GT6 rows incl the Crate + 11 vanilla identities).
